The documentary about Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, generated an estimated $10.6 million in its third weekend, according to figures from Rentrak. That was enough to edge

The domestic movie marketplace generated an estimated $55.7 million from October 30 through November 1, down 42.1% from the previous weekend but up 4.2% from the corresponding weekend in 2025.

For investors in theater chains and entertainment companies, the results highlight the uneven nature of the box office recovery. Domestic ticket sales have reached $8.46 billion year to date, up 20.1% from $7.05 billion during the comparable period last year. However, the sharp weekly decline underscores the industry's continued dependence on a steady supply of compelling releases to sustain attendance.
